fact: Article 391 of Law No. 2017-20 of 20 April 2018 (Digital Code) allows transfer of personal data to a third State or international organisation only when the Authority finds the destination assures an equivalent level of protection.
title: Loi n° 2017-20 du 20 avril 2018 portant code du numérique en République du Bénin
